caption: The drawing depicts a round bowl with a decorated handle attached to the rim at the top. The bowl is shaded to show depth and curvature, with darker shading around the edges and lighter shading in the center. The handle is ornate, featuring a symmetrical, openwork design with a central pointed element and curved motifs. The main bowl and handle composition is centered within a rectangular border. In the lower right corner, there is a small inset diagram showing the side profile of the bowl with its dimensions, labeled as 5 1/16 inches in diameter and 2 3/8 inches in height. The entire drawing is executed in grayscale pencil or charcoal on off-white paper. The signature "Charles Cullen" appears below the rectangular border on the left side.
title: Pewter Porringer
